This shard compiles Section 6.01(b) clauses (12), (18), (19), (27), (31), (32), (33), the post-(33) satisfy-and-discharge permission, the 'for purposes of determining compliance' rules (1)-(2), the accrual/PIK carve-out, the ratio/EBITDA refinancing grandfather rule and its cost add-on, the FX/currency calculation and carve-out rules, and the closing non-subordination interpretive rules.

Clauses 6.01(b)(13) and 6.01(b)(20)-(30) (except (27)) are owned by other shards per the source-omission markers; this shard claims no inventory items from those gaps and represents cross-references to Section 6.01(b)(13) purely as SHARES_CAPACITY_WITH dependsOn entries.

The 'Section 6.01(b)(1)' / 'Section 6.01(b)(1)(X)' / 'Section 6.01(b)(1)(Y)' citations are flagged by Phase 2 as genuinely ambiguous (2 colliding physical occurrences); this is preserved as AMBIGUOUS sufficiency on r11 and as an unresolved dependsOn on r11 and r15, never silently resolved.

'Available RP Capacity Amount', 'Available Amount', 'Not Otherwise Applied', 'Incremental Equivalent Debt' and 'Incremental Cap' were resolved via getDefinition; the four sub-components of 'Incremental Cap' (Fixed/Voluntary Prepayment/Ratio Incremental Amount, Extension Amount) belong to the Incremental Facility mechanics of Section 2.18 and were left as MISSING_CONTEXT dependencies given their remove from this Section 6.01 shard's own scope.

Sections 6.08(a)(3)(b) and 6.08(b) were retrieved via getReferencedProvision to interpret clause (12)(a)'s contribution-basket formula; their own full internal economics (e.g., the complete Available Amount build-up) are not restated here beyond what clause (12)(a) itself cross-references.
